title: Word Ladder
goal: Find the shortest one-letter-at-a-time transformation through allowed words.
strategy: Wildcard buckets connect words differing in one position. BFS explores transformations by distance, and consuming each bucket once avoids repeatedly scanning the same neighbor group.
